desc: t

Abbeys have been centers of monastic life since the earliest Christianity times. Over the centuries, they have become the main foci of religious life, knowledge, and education, as well as centers of economic and social development.
entities.name: Abbey

excludes: reform Restored Rule of the Latins

desc: t
Although we have since lost control of Constantinople, the seat of power for the Empire of Constantinople, our claim to it still remains as strong as ever.

mods.label: Can Create Latin Reconquest Casus Belli

entities.name: Titular Rulers of the Latin Empire

desc: t
Church properties and revenues must be placed under state supervision. Religious institutions will be monitored to align their interests with national policies.
entities.name: Administration Of Clerical Lands

desc: t
A government reform where the ruler is also the superior commander of the navy. Where other states have a fleet, this fleet possesses the state.
entities.name: Admiralty Regime

desc: t

Our lands are cultivated by people of many different beliefs and origins. Fostering a sense of community and centering their shared identity as our subjects will reduce friction and focus everyone on our common goals.
entities.name: Agrarian Community

desc: t
Crop output has been maximized by shifting focus from small-scale farming to the establishment of large plantations.
entities.name: Agricultural Cultivation

desc: t

After the political changes of the last century, the influential House of Doria is promoting a reform of the constitution, eliminating the factions that plagued our republic in the past. These factions are replaced by a new oligarchic government, which includes the twenty-eight most important families, referred to as the Alberghi.
entities.name: The Twenty-Eight Alberghi

desc: t

This set of rules was set up by Swe Magnus Ladulas in 1280 at Alsnö Hus to regulate and formalize the benefits of the Nobility, while also protecting the Peasants from their exploits. This is why he was nicknamed 'Ladulås', or 'Barn-Lock' in English by the commoners.
entities.name: Alsnö Stadga

excludes: event flag: Reformed Nahuatl Society Variable

desc: t

An approximation of a city-state, the Āltepētl is divided into smaller administrative districts called ''calpōlli''. Led by a dynastic ruler, it exudes influence to its surrounding domain and conducts diplomacy with nearby Āltepētl as a sovereign entity.

mods.label: Disallows Taking Land in Peace Treaties

entities.name: Āltepētl

desc: t

A scholarly system of rule, where academics and urban intellectuals hold political power rather than traditional nobility. This system is a government based on intellectual merit and civic participation rather than hereditary rule. The republic maintains control through popular support from the educated elite, though it faces condemnation from those who view it as a threat to the status quo.
entities.name: Ambrosian Republic

requires: situation active: Rise of the Turks

desc: t

Situated in the turbulent region of Anatolia, we have emerged after the decay of the Sultanate of Rûm, whose borders we once inhabited. Hardened warriors and capable bureaucrats form the solid base of our robust government.

mods.label: Unjustified War on Same Religion Penalty

entities.name: Anatolian Beylik

desc: t
Historically, taxes have been imposed and collected only in times of need, not by a recurrent system.
entities.name: Ancient French Taxation

requires: religion group is Andean Folk Religions

desc: t
A government reform common among the people of the Andes. Spiritual beliefs are woven into the succession laws, forcing new rulers to start their reigns owning no worldly possessions whatsoever.
entities.name: Andean Monarchy

desc: t
Heresy and religious dissent must be rooted out through systematic suppression. Doctrinal purity will be maintained to prevent internal division and unrest.
entities.name: Punishment of Heresy

desc: t
Non-traditional combat strategies must be employed against superior forces. Guerrilla tactics, sabotage, and deception will be used to weaken enemy advances.
entities.name: Asymmetrical Warfare Tactics

excludes: event flag: Ath Catalan Company Expelled
requires: event flag: De Brienne Rule Of Athens

desc: t
Since the seizure of the Duchy of Athens, the Catalan Company has projected considerable military influence over Greece.
entities.name: Dominance of the Catalan Company

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Archduchy of Austria)
is a member of Holy Roman Empire

desc: t

We have been granted the ''Privilegium Maius'', which grants us an elevated position among the princes of the Holy Roman Empire. This shows our status and prestige even outside of Imperial lands, and elevates us to a higher position than that of a mere duke.
entities.name: Archduchy of Austria

desc: t

Autocratic monarchies concentrate power in the hands of the ruler. The state is often seen as their personal property. It is not uncommon for rulers to have ministers and supporters, but these are then referred to as members of the royal household.
entities.name: Autocracy

desc: t
Local Nobility must be granted some degree of autonomy. Decentralized governance will prevent uprisings while maintaining feudal obligations to the central authority.
entities.name: Autonomous Estates

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Autonomous Swiss Cantons)

desc: t
The Swiss Cantons retain much of their independent authority even in our unified country, founded on the same ideals as the loose alliance that existed before.
entities.name: Autonomous Swiss Cantons

desc: t

Meaning 'Four Pillars', the Chatusadom ministry organization divides the government into two branches: the military, and civil affairs, the latter of which is further divided into four ministries. The compartmentalization and clear assignment of tasks to each makes for a more effective administration and serves as an extension of the ruler's authority.
entities.name: Chatusadom

desc: t
Financial transactions and state expenditures must be meticulously recorded. A robust system of ledgers will ensure accountability and reduce fraud within the treasury.
entities.name: Bank Ledgers System

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Bank of England)

desc: t

A centralized and influential institution, this bank is made up of powerful financiers and greatly increases our credibility and capacity to handle our debts. Its purpose is to handle public finances, helping to stabilize government borrowing.
entities.name: Bank of England

desc: t
We are not a country; we are more like a family! Or rather, an extended family, all oriented around providing banking services to those in need.
entities.name: Banking Family

excludes: event flag: Gave Autonomy To The Bulala And Sao Variable

desc: t
This complex system of succession laws and administrative procedures establishes religious obligations and requires demonstrations of piety from the ruling dynasty.
entities.name: Banu Hummay Amendments

desc: t

Our most capable nobles will ensure that our influence reaches not only the furthest corners of our realm, but fosters ties to our subjects as well. By sending minor members of our own family as ambassadors to our vassals, we can placate those who govern in our place, and ensure their oversight fulfills our will.
entities.name: Barony Rule

desc: t

A system of feudal land holdings focused on building a formidable cavalry force. Our Sipâhi cavalrymen will be assigned land grants and obligated to provide cavalry forces proportional to the size of their holdings.
entities.name: Timar System

desc: t

The Benevolence Tax is a special tax that targets Nobility with ample savings or those living extravagantly, since they can more easily afford larger contributions. It correspondingly reduces the tax burden on the poorest members of society.
entities.name: Benevolence Tax

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Rapid Industralization)

desc: t

Unlike other nations, we have doubled our efforts towards urbanization and a production-based economy. While this has had the desired beneficial effect on economic matters, much of the peasantry is left worried by such a massive cultural shift.
entities.name: Rapid Industralization

desc: t
The Commonwealth represents a reformed constitution of the Bohemia, giving more privileges and freedom to the various nations living within our borders.
entities.name: Bohemian Commonwealth

desc: t

Our realm upholds the illustrious legacy of Simeon the Great and the emperors of the Bulgarian Tsardom who came before us. Acclaimed by both clergy and nobility, our ruler stands as the guardian of the Bulgaria faith and the cornerstone of South Slavic imperial power in the Balkans.
entities.name: Bulgarian Tsardom

desc: t

The introduction of the Byzantine Court Ceremonies ensures grand ceremonies are carried out in accordance with Byzantine traditions. Meticulous court etiquette is upheld, thereby elevating the prestige and splendor of the ruling elite.
entities.name: Byzantine Court Ceremonies

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Byzantine Influence)

desc: t
Despite having moved to Italy, the Palaiologos of Montferrat remain loyal to their Greek ancestry.
entities.name: Byzantine Influence

desc: t

Our economy is based on the industries of our towns and cities. Providing them with the adequate regulations will ensure that we maintain those industries functioning at their best performance, reducing costs and maximizing benefits.
entities.name: Fueling Economies

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Casa de Contratación)

desc: t

The Casa de Contratación is an agency that administers Spanish colonial operations. All voyages of exploration and trade must receive its approval, and it collects all colonial taxes. The Casa is also charged with safeguarding classified information about new trade routes and valuable discoveries.
entities.name: Casa de Contratación

desc: t

The ancient ways of insular society have been incorporated into our current system of government. Our leader rules the people instead of the land, and trained poets take the place of Clergy in some formal ceremonies.

mods.label: Can Be Member of a High Kingship
Prefers Court Language to be Common Language

entities.name: Celtic Traditions

desc: t
Authority must be consolidated to limit regional autonomy. A strong central government will enhance decision-making efficiency and national stability.
entities.name: Centralization Of Power

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Mandate of the Commons)

desc: t

Many Chinese dynasties have been founded with the support of the Commoners. However, only ours has fully recognized the importance of the common people. No other era in the history of the Middle Kingdom has ever seen such popular support!
entities.name: Mandate of the Commons

desc: t

The Chosen Rada creates a powerful council loyal to the ruler, with sweeping authority to suppress the power of the elites. The council's influence extends to matters of governance, policy, and decision-making.
entities.name: Chosen Rada

desc: t

The Collegium is an overhaul of the administrative structure used for government bureaucracy. It establishes several collegiums as government departments, with a systematic separation of responsibilities to avoid possible overlapping of duties. The collegiums are also tasked with case resolutions, with the help of advisory guidelines.
entities.name: Collegium

desc: t

Our empire spans over the vast oceans of the world, and our mighty fleets ship precious goods from one continent to another. Protecting our fleets and keeping our colonial possession safe from the influence of foreign merchants will ensure our lasting control over all corners of the world.
entities.name: Colonial Empire

desc: t
Overseas territories must be acquired and settled with government support. Strategic investments in colonization will ensure long-term economic and political dominance.
entities.name: Colonial Expansion

desc: t

We are at the forefront of civilization, and this has created opportunities for our most brave and intrepid citizens to cross the world and settle here, seeking to carve out a new and prosperous life of their own.
entities.name: Colonial Subject

desc: t
This is the meeting of all the trade associations of Genoa, and the noble lords of the surrounding valleys and coast, joining together to form the city's government.
entities.name: Compagna Communis

desc: t
We are not a country; we are more like a small army of conquistadors, here to expand our glorious homeland! And to fill our pockets, of course.
entities.name: Conquistador Expedition

desc: t
Military supply chains must be reorganized to improve troop mobility. More efficient logistics will ensure faster deployments and sustained campaigns.
entities.name: Ministry of Conscript Logistics

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Constitutional State)

desc: t

The Constitutional State focuses on the delicate balance between the powers of central authority and representative institutions. While the head of state still governs, laws and policy decisions are shaped by a legislative body, in a valiant attempt to curb absolutist tendencies.
entities.name: Constitutional State

desc: t

The might of our dynasty is imprinted upon the coins that circulate the markets from the Italy coast, to India, and beyond. This trimetallic coin is primarily made of Copper, Silver, and Gold, and is the first of its kind to exert such influence on a multiregional scale. Control of its circulation is synonymous with continued prosperity!
entities.name: Control of the Mahdali Coinage

desc: t
Wishing to further organize the Cossacks under one ruler, the Sich Rada places a Hetman in charge to lead them all, serving either their own interests or the interests of their liege.
entities.name: Sich Rada

desc: t

Also known as the ''Quarantia'', the Council of Forty is the highest constitutional body of the Venetian republic. Although the state is represented by a doge, the real power lies in the hands of the council.
entities.name: Council of Forty

desc: t

The Council of Ten is the major governing body of the Venetian republic, focused on the election of the Doge as well as checking the power of the patricians. Its broad jurisdictional mandate covers many aspects of the security of Venetian state security, and makes it the ''de facto'' ruling institution of the nation.
entities.name: Council of Ten

requires: event flag: Court Of The Star Chamber

desc: t

The Court of the Star Chamber handles cases considered too sensitive or complex for regular courts, ranging from perjury to conspiracy. While known for its efficiency, the court faces criticism for potential abuses of power, lack of due process, and being used as a political tool.
entities.name: Court of the Star Chamber

desc: t

The Crown of Aragon is a composite realm formed by several kingdoms and a principality, each with their own institutions and laws. As a trade and seafaring-oriented confederation, it represents extraordinary naval power, primed to dominate the Mediterranean with its fleets.
entities.name: Crown of Aragon

desc: t

When the Kingdoms of Castile and León formed a definitive union in 1230, the Crown of Castile was born. Since then, the country has aimed to become the hegemonic power in Iberia, and one of the greatest and most prestigious nations in Europe.
entities.name: Crown of Castile

requires: has reform Crusade in the Sea
overlord: has reform Crusade in the Sea

desc: t

As our focus changed from defending castles in the Holy Land to fighting pirates and heathens on the seas, we had to change the way our Order operates. Galleys now will be our battlefields, and our first bulwarks against the enemies of Christ.
entities.name: Crusade in the Sea

desc: t
By recognizing the distinctive nature and valuable contributions of our minority cultures, we can better include them in matters of state.
entities.name: Cultural Recognition

desc: t

Having ultimate authority over their clan territory, Japanese Daimyō are powerful feudal lords, able to recruit their own armies and collect their own taxes. The most influential of them can even show defiance to the central authority of the Shōgun.
entities.name: Daimyō

requires: the reform has been unlocked (College of Missions)

desc: t
The College of Missions is the Danish state-funded association established to help with missionary efforts and converting the population to the true faith.
entities.name: College of Missions

requires: the reform has been unlocked (The King's Law)

desc: t

The King's Law is an absolutionist constitution of Denmark, formalizing the king's absolute authority. It makes the monarch a supreme ruler with all legislative, executive, and judicial powers concentrated in his hands.
entities.name: The King's Law

desc: t

No man should rule a country alone, or else we are no better than the tyrannical despots who try to subjugate our people.
The ''Capitano del Popolo'' shall be a dual position where members of the Spinola and Doria families will each hold office. The rivalry between their ''alberghi'' keeps the Republic restless, but their Diarchs share the burdens of state and their countinghouses keep the coin flowing.
entities.name: Diarchy Republic

desc: t
Diplomatic policies must be centralized for more effective international negotiations. Long-term alliances and agreements will be maintained for stability.
entities.name: Consolidation of Diplomatic Affairs

desc: t
From time immemorial, our people have favored the word above the sword, giving us the ability to forge lasting relationships with our allies, and to build a reputation as honest and loyal.
entities.name: Diplomatic Traditions

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Divided Persian Aristocracy)

desc: t
The ruling military classes of our state are at odds with each other. Where they once challenged the Šâh directly, they now vie constantly for the ruler's favor instead.
entities.name: Divided Persian Aristocracy

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Diwan-i Bandagan)

desc: t
The number of slaves procured by the state has grown so massive that a special department — Diwan-i Bandagan, the Department of Slaves — has been created to manage them and their operations.
entities.name: Diwan-i Bandagan

desc: t

This is a type of republic where the leader, called the ''Stadtholder'', rules for life. Traditionally, the factions supporting this government have fought over how the Stadtholder's power should be structured. Those called the Statists want to make the Stadtholder more like an ''Primus inter Pares'', whereas the Orangists wish to treat the elected leader as some kind of king.
entities.name: Dutch Republic

desc: t

Individual city-states ruled by powerful families, the Dynastic Signoria involves a concentration of power in a small group of influential individuals known as the ''signori''. These individuals, some who were of merchant or banking origins rather than traditional nobility, hold both executive and legislative authority, effectively monopolizing control over their respective cities. They aim to maintain their power at all costs, often resulting in bloody feuds and conflicts between and within houses as they struggle for supremacy.
entities.name: Dynastic Signoria

requires: event flag: Has East India Trading Company

desc: t

A global trading company, its original objective was to trade in the Indian Ocean region. These ventures proved fruitful, and the company later expanded its operations to East Asia.
It is now the largest company in the entire world, controlling and administering large sections of our overseas holdings and our myriad of global trade networks.
entities.name: East India Trading Company

gate: is leader of international organization: middle kingdom
gate_labels: is leader of international organization: middle kingdom
requires: the reform has been unlocked (Empower the Eunuchs)

desc: t

The usefulness of eunuchs cannot be underestimated. They are widely recognized as the most valuable servants, as they can be trusted not to participate in dynastic politics. We shall provide them with better education so that they can fill important government posts.
entities.name: Empower the Eunuchs

desc: t

The Interior Service is a complex branch of the Ottoman household. Divided into the Privy Chamber, the Treasury, the Privy Larder, and the Great and Little Chambers, its ranks consist of a motley crew of eunuchs, slaves, and other little-noticed members of the royal household, who can sometimes wield remarkable influence over the inner workings of the state.
entities.name: Enderûn

desc: t
Religious orthodoxy must be strictly maintained to ensure societal unity. Dissenters will be identified, controlled, and suppressed to prevent unrest.
entities.name: Enforce Religious Adherence

desc: t
Encourage education and high literary standards among the aristocracy in order to ensure that the leaders of our nation closely follow our Humanist ideals.
entities.name: Enlightened Aristocracy

desc: t

Our state must be guided by the principles of enlightened scholars. The councilors guiding our ruler must keep them well-informed and focused on the sole task of ensuring the wellbeing of all our subjects.
entities.name: Enlightened Council

desc: t

Our leadership must be composed only of the brightest minds, no matter their heritage. This inspiring guidance for our people will ensure that our state will have an advantage against our rivals, both in governance and military affairs.
entities.name: Enlightened Leadership

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Local Audiences)

desc: t

Rather than having a stationary court, we prefer the freedom to move at will to other parts of the nation. With our reliance on a Itinerant Court, we can more easily re-adjust where our rulers govern from, and better address the issues of local populations.
entities.name: Local Audiences

desc: t

The Shirley's Militia is an overhaul and retraining of our armed forces, with a focus on modernization and aligning the use of artillery and cavalry in accordance with European practices. This reform strengthens Persia's military power, rivalling that of our enemies.
entities.name: Shirley's Militia

desc: t

Feeding our troops is no easy task, requiring both building up an infrastructure of Grain House facilities and filling these with the yearly harvest. At the same time, our people need to shoulder this additional contribution, otherwise our army would fail to protect our country effectively.
entities.name: Planned Storage System

desc: t
Not only do coin and profit move along the Silk Road, but ideas and knowledge also follow the ebb and flow of the merchants traveling along its path.
entities.name: Exchange of Ideas

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Expanded Posadnichestvo)

desc: t

The office of the Posadnik is a highly influential position. In order to avoid a one-person power monopoly, the office must be expanded, so that multiple members of the Nobility can assume this position at the same time and keep each other in check.
entities.name: Expanded Posadnichestvo

desc: t
The system with landed Sipâhi supplying the bulk of our cavalry has been expanded, assigning them vast tracts of conquered land on which to continue amassing cavalry.
entities.name: Expanded Timar System

desc: t

Our ancient sagas passed down orally through the generations tell of adventurous expeditions to a distant and wild land over the western sea. Perhaps one day we may follow in the footsteps of our forebears...
entities.name: Family Sagas

desc: t

In a feudal kingdom, the power of the monarch is enhanced by a land-owning aristocracy sworn to obey them. The aristocrats, or Nobility , are often landowners in their own right, with considerable influence and vassals of their own.
entities.name: Feudal Nobility

desc: t

A Feudal Theocracy is a state ruled by a religious figurehead. Unlike other theocracies, it is governed in a more hereditary manner, allowing its rulers to pass the leadership to members of their families.
entities.name: Feudal Theocracy

desc: t
Foreign policy must remain adaptable to shifting alliances. Strategic decisions will be made based on the evolving geopolitical landscape.
entities.name: Flexible Diplomatic Stance

desc: t

Our nation has formalized its system of scales, weights, and measures. While it is not universal, the new system does ensure our people use the same basic units of measurement everywhere in the country. Now, there are four bovates to a hide. Or possibly eight. And then five hides equal a fee... er, or do they?
entities.name: Formalized Scales, Weights, and Measures

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Four Articles)

desc: t
A series of demands set forth by our heads of state and faith against the aggressors of the Papal crusades propped up in a weak attempt to suppress our faith.
entities.name: Four Articles

desc: t
Following centuries of disparate legal codes across Northern and Southern France, the ''Code Louis'' has been established, unifying France under one universal legislative system.
entities.name: Louis Legal Code

desc: t

By granting charters that guarantee free trade and protect merchant interests, we encourage commerce to flourish across our realm. Wealthy trading classes gain political influence, shifting power away from the traditional nobility toward those who command capital.
entities.name: Free Market Charters

desc: t

As Princes of the Blood, holders of appanages enjoy a higher standing among the subjects of France, as well as greater privileges. Furthermore, the French monarch is expected to pay them adequate respect in exchange for their assistance in diplomatic affairs.
entities.name: French Appanage

requires: event flag: Enable Centralized Fra Reform

desc: t
Following centuries of heavy decentralization, France has consolidated many of its fragmented appanage and ducal lands, paving the way for a more modern state.
entities.name: French Monarchy

requires: overlord: has reform French Feudal Nobility

desc: t
While the ducal subjects of France lack the autonomy of the appanage domains, they instead enjoy a more cooperative relationship with the Crown.
entities.name: French Ducal

excludes: event flag: Enable Centralized Fra Reform

desc: t
Feudalism has a tight grip on French court affairs. Powerful nobles and autonomous, decentralized subjects have unprecedented amounts of freedom and say in our internal administration.
entities.name: French Feudal Nobility

desc: t

The Frisian Freedom represents the indomitability of our people and their rejection of feudalism and serfdom. They choose their representatives among the landowners and rule the land autonomously. Should a leader rise among them, he must respect the freedoms of his people or face the same fate as any other enemy, whether from within or from the outside.
entities.name: Frisian Freedom

desc: t
The executive institution which overlooks the daily governance and the duties of the Senate. All issues and agendas to be discussed are prepared in this executive body beforehand.
entities.name: Full College

desc: t
A government reform permitting a Salt tax, which places great strain on the populace — and plentiful gold in the state coffers.
entities.name: Gabelle

desc: t
Though we are tethered to the land, the sea is our dominion.
entities.name: Galley Lords

desc: t
Permanent military garrisons must be stationed in key locations to deter threats. Well-supplied and disciplined troops will ensure regional security and rapid mobilization.
entities.name: Garrison System

desc: t

Established by the state to clandestinely intercept and examine all correspondence, this Black Chamber will provide us with intelligence about the postal activity within our country. Our agents' expertise in stealthily opening, copying, and resealing official documents will become renowned throughout the world.
entities.name: Geheime Kabinettskanzlei

desc: t

The Grand Remonstrance is a series of revisions to the separation of powers. It further restricts the power of the monarchy and prohibits clerical cabinet appointments in exchange for increased parliamentary support and a streamlined bureaucracy.
entities.name: Grand Remonstrance

desc: t

Created by Admiral Andrea Doria after reforming the Genoese government, the Great and Minor Councils of Genoa are the two legislative bodies of the state. The Great Council represents the members of the Burghers while the Minor Council is made up of the Nobility.
entities.name: Great and Minor Councils of Genoa

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Guru Granth Sahib)

desc: t
Regarded as the eternal Gurū by Sikhism, it was compiled and expanded by several Gurū across the ages, and it contains all teaching to guide the Sikhism faithful.
entities.name: Guru Granth Sahib

desc: t
The country is led by a wise Gurū, tending to the spiritual needs of the populace as well as more mundane matters and guiding the faithful to enlightenment.
entities.name: Gurū Leadership

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Geheimer Rat)

desc: t
The Geheimer Rat serves as a central advisory body to the monarch. Comprised of high-ranking nobles, ministers, and confidants, the council played a crucial role in shaping Imperial policies.
entities.name: Geheimer Rat

desc: t

The Haixi Jurchen are a group of Jurchen people who are primarily focused on pastoralism rather than agriculture, which differentiates them from Jianzhou Jurchen. They are also known for their adoption of many Mongolian traditions.
entities.name: Haixi Jurchen

desc: t
This represents a decentralized federation of merchants united under one alliance. Its members occupy special buildings across the entirety of Europe and are known for their mercantile prowess.

mods.label: Prefers Court Language to be Market Language

entities.name: Hanseatic Merchant Federation

desc: t
Port facilities must be efficiently managed to support maritime trade and naval operations. Corruption will be reduced, and commerce will thrive under structured supervision.
entities.name: Harbor Administration

desc: t

The Clan Mothers of the Haudenosaunee, called ''Iakoianes'', hold the major authority within clans. They are responsible for the internal workings of the tribe and for electing their male counterparts, called Royaner, to represent the clan's interests at the council of all the Haudenosaunee tribes.
entities.name: Haudenosaunee Clan Mothers

desc: t

Our country must remain resilient against foreign threats, even before rival powers can reveal their intentions. By carefully planning our diplomatic connections with foreign countries, we can reduce the risk of their fabricating pretexts for war against us.
entities.name: Hermit Country

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Holy Imperial Monarchy)

desc: t
The Empire has reached its maximum splendor. As the only legal successor to the Roman Empire, no one can deny our divinely-favored right to rule!
entities.name: Holy Imperial Monarchy

desc: t
Mobile artillery units must be deployed to increase battlefield flexibility. Rapid movement and powerful firepower will be combined for tactical superiority.
entities.name: Horse Artillery Corps

desc: t
Social welfare initiatives must be implemented to improve public well-being. Addressing poverty and instability will strengthen state control and prevent revolts.
entities.name: Humanitarian Administration

desc: t
The powerful magnates of Hungary reduced the power of the Crown at every opportunity.
entities.name: Powerful Magnates

desc: t

Ruled by a Islam minority, the Sultanates of India have had to evolve and expand the traditional Islam ideas of kingship. While they remain Islamic states, the role of the Dhimmi, which traditionally encompasses Jews and Christians, has been extended to the Dharmic religions.
entities.name: Indian Sultanate

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Intendancy System)

desc: t

The Intendancy System is a new system of governance aimed at centralizing the authority of the Crown over that of the bureaucrats in order to oversee tax collection and implement anti-corruption measures.
entities.name: Intendancy System

desc: t
Our authority rests in the titles granted to us by the Lord of Ireland.
entities.name: Irish Earldom

requires: the reform has been unlocked (The Grand Council)

desc: t

Comprised of fifty chiefs from each of the Five Nations, the Haudenosaunee Grand Council carries out the principles of the Great Law of Peace. The council's governance requires all fifty chiefs to reach a unified consensus before affairs can continue.
entities.name: The Grand Council

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Great Law of Peace)

desc: t

Enshrined through Wampum belts, the framework for the Great Law of Peace has governed our Confederacy since its inception. Emphasizing peace and justice, along with maintaining a steady mind, the principles of the Great Law of Peace have united all within the Haudenosaunee nation.
entities.name: Great Law of Peace

desc: t
Our entire administration is organized around maintaining the sheer number of castles that control our hills and valleys, making us one of the most fortified countries in the world.
entities.name: The Iron Ring

desc: t

We have encouraged the study of Western matters. While some fear it is detrimental to our societal cohesion, others argue that lessons to be learned from the West are so valuable that we could not afford to do otherwise.
entities.name: Rangaku

desc: t

As a result of the Imperial family's inability to effectively control the countryside, the numerous samurai clans have established their own power bases. The military structure of government under the Shōgun is fertile ground for the constant power struggles between them.
entities.name: Japanese Clan

desc: t
Claiming descent from the sun goddess Amaterasu, the Yamato dynasty has sat upon the Chrysanthemum Throne for centuries.
entities.name: Japanese Imperial Family

desc: t
Being a Jianzhou Jurchen means being a highly Sinicized Jurchen group, highly agricultural and permanently settled. These Jurchen peoples have intensive trading networks with nearby Chinese cities.
entities.name: Jianzhou Jurchen

desc: t

Many German princes still uphold the tradition of sharing power with their siblings — splitting the duties of governance, ruling their holdings jointly, or even taking turns on the throne for a pre-determined period.
entities.name: Joint Ruling

desc: t

The Joyous Entry grants liberties to our Burghers, akin to a ''Magna Carta'' for the Low Countries. This document upholds freedoms for the church, towns, and Nobility, emphasizing consent for taxes and commitments to our nation's indivisibility.
entities.name: Joyous Entry

desc: t
The Judicate is a unique type of government which is defined by its republic-like institutions, and by electing the ruler from within the Supreme Court.
entities.name: Judicate

requires: has dlc: D008 Fate Of The Phoenix

desc: t

The answer to warmongering neighbors is the consolidation of newly conquered territory through resolute military authority. Originating from the word ''katepánō'' — the one placed at the top — the Katepanáta stand above the ordinary themes, grouping provinces beneath a single commander invested with both civil and martial power. First employed with prominence in the 10th and 11th centuries, from Italy with its seat at Bari to the volatile frontiers of Armenia under emperors such as Basil II, these great districts ensured that distant and contested lands were not left to fragmented rule. Let these bastions of our willpower serve as a banner against all those who seek to take our crown from us!
entities.name: Katepanáta

desc: t
By seeking advice from the leaders of our most important clans, we can achieve a more stable government, and hopefully bring more prosperity to our society.
entities.name: Council of Clan Heads

desc: t

A series of loose confederations, often led by a governor that strengthens the power of local merchants, these communities push for local autonomy and urbanization. Their trading skills provide a steady stream of revenue for our treasuries.
entities.name: Kilwan Trade Communities

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Kingdom of God)

desc: t
We have established the Kingdom of God on Earth. The authority of the Church, led by the Rome, shall be absolute in both the spiritual and temporal realms.
entities.name: Kingdom of God

desc: t

Also known as ''Uniform Land Tax Law'', Daedongbeob changes the tax regime to be based on uniform Wheat contributions. This set of reforms should improve the lives of the Commoners and increase the commercial potential of our Burghers.
entities.name: Daedongbeob

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Sadae Policy)
is subject of: Middle Kingdom.Leader Country

desc: t

Sadae Policy maintains a close relationship between Korea and China, where the former is treated as a junior partner of the latter. With this, we remain subservient to the Middle Kingdom, and must strive to maintain good relations with the Chinese.
entities.name: Sadae Policy

desc: t

The Kritai Katholikoi, colloquially referred to as the ''Universal Justices of the Romans'', have come to represent the pinnacle of Byzantine legal authority, born from the reforms of Byz Andronikos II Palaiologos and initially comprising of twelve judges from both secular and ecclesiastical backgrounds. Later streamlined to a panel of four, this illustrious court holds unparalleled authority with no recourse for appeal.
entities.name: Kritai Katholikoi

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Reformed Kritai Katholikoi)

desc: t

Although the judiciary system created by Byz Andronikos II Palaiologos saw initial success, there were still internal issues, which the judges exploited to pursue their interests. With the reforms of this Supreme Court, existing legal processes have been streamlined while ensuring no corruption between the judges.
entities.name: Reformed Kritai Katholikoi

desc: t
By granting even the lowliest Commoners the right to inherit and continue using the lands of their forefathers, we shall gain productivity as a state.
entities.name: Peasant Land Inheritance

requires: is a member of Holy Roman Empire

desc: t

A Landgraviate, named after a ''Landgraf'', acts as an immediate jurisdiction of the Holy Roman Empire in otherwise fractured counties. The Landgrave is a direct representative of the law of the Hre in the lands of the Landgraviate, and the title is comparable to a Duke in power and responsibilities.
entities.name: Landgraviate

excludes: reform Restored Rule of the Latins
requires: event flag: Lat Accepted Pope Latin Empire Proposal

desc: t
Although the Empire of Constantinople has since been destroyed by the Empire of Byzantium, recent crusader state campaigns in Greece have encouraged Roman sponsorship to restore the empire.

mods.label: Can Create Latin Reconquest Casus Belli

entities.name: Roman Backing to Retake Constantinople

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Restored Rule of the Latins)

desc: t

Once thought to be lost forever to a resurgent Byzantium, the Empire of Constantinople has at long last been restored in Constantinople, and once against serves as a bastion of Catholicism rule throughout Greece.

mods.label: Can Create Latin Reconquest Casus Belli

entities.name: Restored Rule of the Latins

desc: t

The integration of our subjects territory into our own administration is a difficult task, made even harder by the negative sentiment carried to other countries. The establishment of new offices will be able to mitigate this, at least to those countries who already swear fealty to us.
entities.name: Integration Offices

gate: situation:rise of the ottomans.var:strongest beylik variable this: root
gate_labels: situation:rise of the ottomans.var:strongest beylik variable this: root

desc: t

In the midst of chaos lies opportunity. Our leadership over the affairs of Anatolia, as well as our military and financial might, have given us the first say in determining the future of the entire region.
entities.name: Leader of the Turks

desc: t

We are the descendants of the great conqueror of the world, Genghis Khān. His blood runs through our veins, making us a proud and powerful people, and promising us that everywhere our horses can take us shall be ours to conquer!
entities.name: Legacy of Genghis Khān

gate: is leader of international organization: middle kingdom
gate_labels: is leader of international organization: middle kingdom

desc: t

kublai_khan was the one who solidified our rule over China. He adopted the style of the Chinese and proclaimed himself Huángdì of the Middle Kingdom. As long as we follow in his footsteps, our authority over the Dragon Throne will be recognized.
entities.name: Legacy of kublai_khan

requires: event flag: Tur Rise Of Ottoman Flag

desc: t

The Legacy of Osman is a tradition of divine right to expand under the central religious and political authority of our supreme leader. We invoke the Legacy to justify our continued conquests, maintain dynastic legitimacy across diverse holdings, and create an empire where our conquered peoples are not merely subjugated, but fully absorbed. Failure to uphold the Legacy can be seen as a betrayal to our people's traditions.
entities.name: Legacy of Osman

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Legacy of the Ottomans)

desc: t
After centuries of warfare and triumphant victories, we have finally consolidated vast territories under our banner. The whole of Europe will tremble at the sound of our approach!
entities.name: Legacy of the Ottomans

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Legacy of the Turks)

desc: t

Besting our powerful neighbors across Anatolia has given way to a new rising power! After centuries of warfare and triumphant victories, we have finally consolidated vast territories under our banner. The whole of Europe will tremble at the sound of our approach!
entities.name: Legacy of the Turks

desc: t
We are the Pope's representative north of the Alps!
entities.name: Legatus Natus

desc: t

Originally granted to the von Babenberg dynasty, which ruled before us, this privilege allows us to select our preferred heir in the case there are none in the direct male line. This will ensure our dynasty retains their possessions even during dire times.
entities.name: Libertas Affectandi

desc: t
We have adopted strict rules and regulations about what can be printed. Hopefully, this will silence anyone seeking to make treasonous or abusive statements about our society.
entities.name: Licensing of the Press

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Lǐfān Yuàn)

desc: t

The Lǐfān Yuàn is a a department that administers the state's territories and policies in Inner Asia, such as the provinces in Mongolia, Tibet, and Xinjiang. Should the need ever arise, it will also oversee any holdings further inland.
entities.name: Lǐfān Yuàn

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Supreme Dukedom)

desc: t
Rather than styling ourselves as the equal of other dukes, we instead choose to be elevated to a status that better expresses our strength.
entities.name: Supreme Dukedom

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Livonian Confederation)

desc: t

The lands of Baltic have long been disunited, splintered into many different subservient bishoprics and vassals. Instead of trying to unite Terra Mariana into a centralized state, we shall embrace this decentralization.
entities.name: Livonian Confederation

desc: t
Military recruitment and training must be localized for better response to regional threats. Supplies and logistics will be improved to strengthen provincial forces.
entities.name: Local Army Organization

desc: t
The common people should not wait until foreign powers come and take away their homes, families, and futures. Instead, every citizen must be ready to give up their lives for a brighter future.
entities.name: Libertas!

desc: t

The 'Great Charter' is a legal document that aims to protect the feudal rights of our barons against unjust taxation and legal maneuvers by the Crown. It is also one of the earliest documents to enshrine the idea of civil liberties, such as the right to a fair trial and protection from illegal imprisonment.
entities.name: Magna Carta

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Malian Tribute System)

desc: t
Our primary source of Gold, the Malian Tribute System is a system which demands that all Gold is taxed and ultimately controlled by the ruler.
entities.name: Malian Tribute System

desc: t

The Sultanate's rule over the vastness of Egypt depends greatly on maintaining a powerful standing army. Its upper class consists of factions of these powerful slave soldiers, who often ascend to the throne themselves, and can be the deciding factor between a long and short reign.
entities.name: Mamlūk Government

desc: t

The Mandala is a system of power in which independent city states swear fealty to whoever leads the most powerful state among them. Stemming from the Dharma and Buddhism worldview, the fundamental idea is that power emanates radially from a center source. Thus, each of the polities is a source of local power, but their power in turn radiates from the central, most powerful, source.
entities.name: Mandala System

desc: t
Military conscription must be enforced to maintain a strong standing army. All eligible citizens will be required to serve in defense of the state.
entities.name: Mandatory Service

desc: t

The Manden Kurufa, also known as the Manden Federation, is the government of the Empire of Mali. Originally started as the '''Twelve Doors''' which were the personal possessions of the Mansa, this network of alliances and conquered lands has become the core government of the state.
entities.name: Manden Kurufa

desc: t

This innovative style synthesizes aspects of Late Gothic architecture with influences from the Spanish, Italian, and Flemish traditions. The construction in Manueline was largely financed by proceeds from the lucrative spice trade with Africa and India.
entities.name: Manueline Architecture

requires: is a member of Holy Roman Empire

desc: t

A Margraviate is a historical territorial jurisdiction, named after a ''Markgraf'', or 'count on the frontier', who serves to defend and administer the border regions of a realm, mostly focused on repelling external threats. Margraviates blend military defense with governance; the Margrave's responsibilities include safeguarding the frontier and managing local affairs, bridging the gap between the central authority and these border territories.
entities.name: Margraviate

desc: t

By instituting a system of mass conscription, we can draw upon the full population of our realm for military service. This broad mobilization swells our armies with common soldiers, embracing the philosophy that victory comes through numbers rather than individual skill.
entities.name: Mass Levy System

gate: has global variable: league of public weal enabled
gate_labels: has global variable: league of public weal enabled
Member of the League of Public Weal
requires: has global variable: League Of Public Weal Enabled
overlord: has reform French Feudal Nobility
has reform Member of the League of Public Weal

desc: t

By becoming part of the League of Public Weal, we commit to joining any future wars waged against the ruler of France. But, should any such conflict fail, the French crown would be emboldened to confiscate lands from disloyal subjects...

mods.label: Disallowed from Call Subject to War

entities.name: Member of the League of Public Weal

desc: t
Private military forces must be registered and regulated to ensure discipline. Mercenary companies will be held accountable, preventing instability and betrayal.
entities.name: Mercenary Registration

desc: t
A republic founded upon the principles of trade. The flow of commerce is the most important factor for the families who rule these republics.

mods.label: Prefers Court Language to be Market Language

entities.name: Merchant Republic

desc: t

Ashta Pradhan - ''Modern Council of Ministers'' - is the system of ministerial delegation used by the Marathi people. The council is tasked with guiding the administration of the state, overviewing matters of the military, finances, diplomacy, and religion alike.
entities.name: Ashta Pradhan

desc: t
Land grants must be allocated to military officers to secure their loyalty. In return, they will maintain standing forces prepared for immediate deployment.
entities.name: Military Allotment

desc: t

The Military Orders were created in the Middle Ages as a militant body of the Catholicism Church. They are made up of warriors, named ''miles'', as well as monks called ''fratres'' who have taken solemn religious vows to defend and spread the Christianity faith.

mods.label: May be Target of Military Sponsorships

entities.name: Military Order

desc: t
A form of government where the ruler is picked from the staff of generals of the army. The government serves the army!
entities.name: Military Regime

desc: t
Resource-rich regions must be developed into organized mining communities. State supervision will ensure efficient extraction and stable labor conditions.
entities.name: Mining Communities

desc: t

Originally an instrument for resolving local disputes between peasants, the Council of Justice has developed into the land's most prominent court, handling cases and operating as a shield for our people.
entities.name: Council of Justice

desc: t

The Secret Council is a body of nobly-born individuals. Its jurisdiction encompasses our entire domain, and often clashes against the ruler's agenda. The majority of critical decisions made by or on behalf of the ruler frequently fall under the Secret Council's review.
entities.name: Secret Council

desc: t
Offensive warfare doctrines must be refined for greater battlefield efficiency. New tactics will emphasize speed, coordination, and overwhelming force.
entities.name: Modern Assault Tactics

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Modern Imperial Army)

desc: t

The old Decayed Theme System of Byzantium proved faulty, strengthening the authority of governors and generals rather than the ruler. As a result, a new Imperial Army has formed, one where being a soldier is a profession rather than a duty.
entities.name: Modern Imperial Army

requires: has dlc: D008 Fate Of The Phoenix

desc: t

Rome was never exclusively Greek. Our titles, our laws, and the memory of the Eternal City descend from a Latin tradition older than our current tongue. The Mōs Maiōrum formalizes this heritage: palace offices are reordered around ancient Roman precedent, the court tongue shifts to Latin, and our diplomats find their work cheaper to sustain.
entities.name: Mōs Maiōrum

desc: t

If there is one thing our dynasty has learned over the centuries, it is that we must adopt the native ways of conquered peoples and absorb them into our culture. Let us ensure that we learn from those we conquer so that our empire can continue to expand.
entities.name: Mughal Diwan

desc: t
Foreign negotiations must be conducted by linguistically skilled diplomats. Multilingual representatives will strengthen diplomatic ties and improve trade agreements.
entities.name: Multilingual Diplomats

desc: t

The Nakaz is an overhaul of the legal code concerning equality, justice, and humanitarianism. Heavily influenced by the Enlightenment, it aims to emulate the progressive reforms that are taking place across Europe, whilst simultaneously simplifying the code of law.
entities.name: Nakaz

desc: t
An assembly composed of representatives of the entire nation. Depending on the type of government, it may have all the powers of government, or only legislative ones.
entities.name: National Assemblies

desc: t

Not event the cultural might of China is able to influence our traditions. We are proud of our culture and heritage, and we will not allow any foreign influence to dictate the conditions and workings of our rule.
entities.name: National Traditions

desc: t
Naval training programs must be expanded to improve leadership at sea. A more skilled officer corps will enhance fleet command.
entities.name: Nautical Education

desc: t
Shipbuilding efforts must be expanded to strengthen naval forces. Greater investment in warships will ensure maritime dominance and protect trade routes.
entities.name: Prioritize Military Shipbuilding

desc: t
Shipyards, docks, and coastal defenses must be expanded. Greater investment in naval infrastructure will ensure maritime supremacy and facilitate large-scale operations.
entities.name: Administration of Shipyards

desc: t

The Navy Board is an administrative body responsible for overseeing naval affairs. This centralized institution streamlines fleet management, resulting in more efficient operations and resource allocation.
entities.name: Navy Board

desc: t

In order to better control our holdings and further our military ambitions, we have divided many of our territorial possessions among Nayaks. These Nayaks are expected to administer these lands and to maintain any cities, temples, and settlements within them, as well as to provide the armies we need to defend and expand our kingdom.
entities.name: Nayankara System

desc: t

With the invention of the ''fluyte'', the Dutch shipbuilding industry has exploded. Domestic and foreign orders are streaming in, and business is booming! Never before have so many Dutch ships sailed the seas, and never before have so many of our people been employed in building them.
entities.name: Dutch Shipbuilding Industry

desc: t

Many of our towns and cities cling to outdated rights, granted to them centuries ago. For those urban areas to remain competitive we must ensure their privileges remain sensible for their current status within our country.
entities.name: Modernization of Urban Rights

desc: t

In this republic, the right to rule is hereditary within certain noble dynasties. These families elect the ruler from within their dynasty, and this head of government will in turn depend on their support.
entities.name: Noble Elite

desc: t
The deeds of our upper class must exceed any expectations put on them, to be an inspiration for our people and serve as the model of the ideal citizen for them to emulate.
entities.name: Noblesse Oblige

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Nueva Planta)

desc: t
The Nueva Planta is a series of decrees and reforms formalized in order to abolish regional legal privileges and forge a single, unitary state under central authority.
entities.name: Nueva Planta

desc: t
The proud lineage of our nobles, standing far taller on two legs than the rulers of any other nation on Earth, should be evident to all!
entities.name: Of Noble Bearing

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Overseas Ambitions)

desc: t

While the concepts of overseas expansion and colonialism have existed since antiquity, we have observed the modern ways of colonialism and have employed them ourselves. This will allow us to adopt their methods of overseas administration and create our own colonial empire.
entities.name: Overseas Ambitions

desc: t

The hereditary Nobility poses the greatest threat to our command of the state. We must break their power by seizing portions of their estates and redistributing this land to those who demonstrate loyalty to us.
entities.name: Oprichnina

desc: t
Marine forces must be formally structured for amphibious warfare. Specialized training and disciplined formations will improve coastal and naval engagements.
entities.name: Organized Marines

requires: event flag: Tur Coffee House Paranoia

desc: t
Coffee houses and other urban meeting places are major hotspots for subversive activities. By seeding these places with our loyal spies and informants, we can better safeguard state security.
entities.name: Coffee House Espionage

desc: t

Skilled eunuch servants can be granted powerful positions such as Black Chief Eunuch, ''Kızlar Ağası'', and White Chief Eunuch, ''Kapı Ağası''. In these roles, they are responsible for communications between the ruler and the Ottomans, as well as administration of the harem and pages, supervision of ''waqf'' foundations, and the education of Ottoman princes, among many other things. Considered more trustworthy than their intact peers, they can be relied on to always work for the benefit of the state.
entities.name: Eunuch Viziers

desc: t

The Imperial Harem is much more than a collection of enslaved beauties at the ruler's beck and call - it is an institution parallel to the Interior Service, with its own organization, education, and protocols. Though those in the harem must work behind the scenes, they can sometimes wield great influence, turning the tides of state with merely a whisper in the right ear.
entities.name: Imperial Harem

desc: t

A reform to the Muqāta'ah system, Malikâne allows tax farmers to purchase lifelong contracts for tax collection rights in the areas they farm. This provides them with more security and incentivizes long-term investment in their region's overall economic development. The drawback of this system is that maintaining rule of law over these lifetime grants will become more difficult.
entities.name: Malikâne

excludes: event flag: Disbanded the Ottoman New Order Army
requires: event flag: Unlocked Ottoman New Order Army

desc: t

A radical military reform, the New Order Army relies heavily on foreign instructors and Western tactics and weapons, as well as reorganizing the artillery corps. May it lead us to new victories, and further diminish the troublesome influence of the moribund Janissaries.
entities.name: Niẓām-i Jedīd

requires: capital: has building with at least one level: Admiralty

desc: t

The Overhauled Admiralty is an attempt to modernize the governing body of the Royal Navy. The reform helps strengthen our naval power while also laying the foundation for the navy's future successes as a formidable maritime entity.
entities.name: Overhauled Admiralty

desc: t
The Holy See is the jurisdiction of the Bishop of Rome, the ''Pontifex Maximus'', head of the Catholicism Church, known as The Rome.
entities.name: Holy See

excludes: reform Restored Rule of the Latins

desc: t

After the Fourth Crusade, the Eastern Roman Empire was partitioned among several Western European families, who then founded a series of Crusader Principalities. While these polities existed, they were a constant threat to the Empire.
entities.name: Partitio Terrarum Imperii Romaniae

desc: t
The government is run directly by the ruler as an extension of their household. Armies, bureaucrats, and subjects swear loyalty directly to the sitting ruler, and not to the state.
entities.name: Patrimonialism

desc: t

Giving our population the legal protection against those who wish to exploit them will help our land and people prosper. With a robust legal system protecting peasants and laborers from abuse, while also increasing their opportunity of education, we can achieve a long lasting increase of our productivity.
entities.name: Guaranteed Labor Rights

desc: t
A form of government in which the Crown, Nobility, and Clergy are very weak or non-existent, granting a high degree of autonomy to the Commoners.

mods.label: Prefers Court Language to be Common Language

entities.name: Peasant Republic

desc: t

The Šâh is the absolute ruler of Persia, and under the Šâh exists a complex bureaucratic system that keeps the nation structured and balanced. With positions in the government assigned by merit instead of heritage, the system is assured to function to the best benefit of the nation.
entities.name: Persian Feudal Theocracy

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Petition of Rights)

desc: t

The citizens within our borders, particularly those with noble connections, have long demanded the adoption of certain inalienable rights. These would impact the cooperation of our estates and our capacity for governmental reforms at the cost of a weaker central authority.
entities.name: Petition of Rights

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Peuplierung System)

desc: t
The Peuplierung System is an initiative that aims to attract immigrants to settle in the sparsely populated regions of the nation.
entities.name: Peuplierung System

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Pirate Brethren)

desc: t
Insofar as this loose collection of pirate crews can be called a state, the Pirate Brethren is a haven for all manner of thieves, murderers, and smugglers.

mods.label: Prefers Court Language to be Common Language

entities.name: Pirate Brethren

desc: t
The influence of wealthy elites in governance must be encouraged. Burghers and financiers will shape policies to promote economic expansion and private enterprise.
entities.name: Plutocratic Ethos

desc: t
A Monarchy that manages its finances by relying on the merchant class and securing the flow of commerce.
entities.name: Plutocratic Monarchy

desc: t

Strategic delays during negotiations are a great way to put our thumb on the diplomatic scale. By establishing ourselves as the strongest side in an exchange, through these tactics, we will inevitably extract more value from every foreign deal.
entities.name: Policy Of Calculated Delay

desc: t
The Casa da Índia oversees all Portuguese possessions in Africa and India, and controls all the rights to trade there.
entities.name: Casa da Índia

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Portuguese Ordinances)

desc: t
This formalization of the canon, Roman, and country laws will resolve many judicial conflicts and increase the efficiency of the government.
entities.name: Portuguese Ordinances

desc: t

Despite its monarchy initially being like those of other Iberian nations, Portugal has developed a slightly different government: more centralized around its monarchs, with better leverage over its estates, and with a keen eye towards reaping the riches of overseas trade.
entities.name: Portuguese Monarchy

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Powerful Vizierships)

desc: t
A set of ministers who supercede the authority of the ruler, these councilors hold a firm grip on power, while the Sultan is but a mere puppet.
entities.name: Powerful Vizierships

desc: t

The Prikazi is an overhaul of the administrative structure used for government bureaucracy. It establishes several bureaus that are responsible for various aspects of governance, such as taxation, justice, military affairs, and trade, which facilitates more rapid implementation of the policies and decisions made by the Tsar.
entities.name: Prikazi

desc: t
We hold the prestigious title of Primas Germaniae, distinguishing us as one of the most important ecclesiastical offices in the Holy Roman Empire.
entities.name: Primas Germaniae

desc: t

A Prince-Bishop is an ordained member of a faith who is also the civil ruler of a territory. The religious territory that the Prince-Bishops rules over does not need to coincide with the secular territory they own.
entities.name: Prince Bishopric

desc: t
Staying informed about events within one's domain is vital for any ruler. By establishing a privy council, we will be able to keep a much closer eye on our people.
entities.name: Privy Council

desc: t
Manufacturing output must be regulated through government quotas. Centralized supervision will prevent shortages and maintain economic stability.
entities.name: Production Quota Bureaus

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Promissione Ducale)

desc: t
The Promissione Ducale serves as the formal oath of office and contractual agreement that each newly elected Doge of Venice must swear to uphold.
entities.name: Promissione Ducale

desc: t

We can ease all foreign diplomacy by investing into a network of Provincial Chancery buildings. With that, we can ensure that foreign envoys can reach our representatives much faster and speed up our communication with foreign powers.
entities.name: Provincial Consulates

desc: t
Tax collection must be standardized across provinces to ensure consistent revenue. Corrupt officials will be removed, and financial supervision will be strengthened.
entities.name: Provincial Taxation System

desc: t
We have gone to great lengths to unify our internal legal systems, rooting out abuse and malpractice while creating a professional judiciary.
entities.name: Unified Legal System

desc: t
A form of government under a monarch, which puts great focus on administrative efficiency — especially in military matters, if the situation calls for it.
entities.name: Prussian Monarchy

desc: t
The poor suffer most in times of trouble. Some small donations shall help to ease their misery - and hopefully ensure that the mob will not pick up their torches and pitchforks...
entities.name: Public Welfare

desc: t

The ''Fuero'' is realized in written law, limiting royal power and ensuring the exercise of civil liberties. Only when new rulers swear to protect the ''Fueros'' are they recognized as such. The ''Fueros'' are the constitutions of the realm, subjecting power to the rule of law and expressing the balance of power between our state and our rulers.
entities.name: Pyrenean Fueros

desc: t

The Razriadnyi Prikaz introduces a census, which is used to maintain records of the country's population, property, and taxation. It is updated at regular intervals, assesses the military obligations of the estates, and maintains a record of land and property ownership, ensuring that what is due is paid.
entities.name: Razriadnyi Prikaz

desc: t
Government records must be meticulously maintained for administrative efficiency. Accurate documentation will prevent corruption and streamline bureaucracy.
entities.name: Expanded Archives

requires: event flag: Reformed Nahuatl Society Variable

desc: t

An innovative series of centralization reforms and legislative frameworks form the basis of our new government. With attention to detail and strong centralized authority, this legal foundation will cement the rise of a powerful nation, adherent to Nahua teachings.
entities.name: Reformed Nahua Society

requires: religion group is Andean Folk Religions

desc: t

This reformed government fundamentally restructures Incan governance by eliminating the traditional ''panaca'' system, which protected the holdings and possessions of the dead ruler and therefore forced the new Sapa Inca to push for expansion. Instead, it concentrates all power in the hands of the new leader.
entities.name: Reformed Tawantinsuyu Government

gate: is leader of international organization: hre
gate_labels: is leader of international organization: hre

desc: t
The Reichshofrat serves as the highest legal institution for Austria and Holy Roman Empire both, giving us stronger control over the legal processes of both our direct and imperial subjects.
entities.name: Reichshofrat

desc: t

Let us look much more closely to our holy scriptures to determine appropriate crimes and penalties for our society. After all, when a society is ruled in a truly pious fashion, it makes it far easier for devout citizens to weed out the traitors and deviants among them.
entities.name: Religious Laws Enforced

desc: t

Our country is populated by people who practice different beliefs. Therefore, it would be prudent to govern in a tolerant manner with them, ensuring the support for our government regardless of their religion.
entities.name: Religious Tolerance

desc: t

By establishing representative assemblies that give voice to the common people, we decentralize authority and foster broader political participation. Local governance becomes more responsive, and individual liberties are enshrined as a cornerstone of our political order.
entities.name: Representative Assemblies

desc: t

The introduction of the Representative Parliament marks a significant shift in political dynamics, granting the opportunity for individuals from humble backgrounds, such as Peasants, to secure a seat in Parliament. This privilege has traditionally been the exclusive domain of the elite and privileged classes.
entities.name: Representative Parliament

desc: t
While on the surface a Republic, the Revolutionary Autocracy is akin to an absolute Military Dictatorship led by a competent general or admiral who enjoys great popularity amongst the masses.
entities.name: Revolutionary Autocracy

desc: t

The Revolutionary Empire is a Monarchy which makes some concessions to the ideas of the Enlightenment, while ruling over the people with absolute power under the pretext of serving revolutionary ideals.
entities.name: Revolutionary Empire

desc: t

The Revolutionary Republic governs the nation through a small executive authority, supported by an elective chamber of deputies. Revolutionary propaganda will strengthen the resolve of our armies, and the principal of universal equality should inspire strong and confident leadership.
entities.name: Revolutionary Republic

desc: t

Our rule is defined by the ancestral traditions of China, and the virtues of benevolence, righteousness, respect, wisdom, sincerity, and loyalty among many others are the guiding compass of our administration. Such government cannot but be blessed by Heaven itself.
entities.name: Rigtheous Government

desc: t
Investigating suspicious behavior within the administration might be a good idea from time to time. Creating more royal commissions will certainly help to reduce corruption.
entities.name: Royal Commissions

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Royal Council of Castile)

desc: t
The Royal Council of Castile is a centralized royal council to streamline taxation, justice, and administration under the direct oversight of the Crown.
entities.name: Royal Council of Castile

desc: t
The monarch rules supreme in this country, and loyalty is valued above all else. We must ensure that decrees from the royal court are followed to the letter, and in all parts of our country.
entities.name: Royal Decree

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Royal Factories)

desc: t
Royal Factories are state-funded manufactories directly overseen by the Crown to produce strategic and luxury goods in support of mercantilist and centralized economic policies.
entities.name: Royal Factories

excludes: event flag: Rise Of Szlachta Szlachta Outcome Variable
gate_labels: Rise Of Szlachta Szlachta Outcome Variable
requires: event flag: Had Sejm Event Variable
event flag: Rise Of Szlachta Szlachta Outcome Variable

desc: t

The undisputed authority across our lands are the Nobility as they channel their influence through the Poland. Their voices shape our politics and may yet determine the fate of our entire country, for better or worse...

mods.label: Cannot Declare Wars without Casus Belli

entities.name: Rule of the Sejm

desc: t

A commission of Nobility has effectively taken over the management of the kingdom, acting as regents. The monarch's ability to exercise power is limited, and their right to rule diminishes over time. The commission can only rule for as long as it retains the support of the parliament, or until such a time that the ruler amasses enough support to overthrow it.
entities.name: Ruling Commission

desc: t

The backbone of our economy is found in the raw goods of our land. By granting charters to our burghers to oversee those operations from local companies, we can guarantee a rapid and efficient expansion of our extractions.
entities.name: Rural Oligarchy

desc: t
The obligation to heed the advice of any council has been abolished.
entities.name: Absolutism

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Samsa System)

desc: t

Also known as the ''Three Offices'', the Samsa is a collective term for the three major government offices of our state. Composed of members chosen for meritocratic and academic accomplishments, Samsa System ensures checks and balances on the ruler and officials alike.
entities.name: Samsa System

requires: event flag: Sbl Civil War Victor

desc: t
The lords disinherited by the treasonous Sco Robert De Brus 1St Lord Of Annandale now flock to our banner on our promise of restoring their rightful holdings!
entities.name: Restorer of the Disinherited

desc: t

Promoted by religious orders and municipalities, the Schools of First Letters undertake the mission of educating people not only in the basics of catechism, but also of numbers and letters. By supporting these endeavors, our people learn to read and write correctly, becoming more educated in the process.
entities.name: School of First Letters

desc: t
Introduced by Sco Malcolm III, the shire system divides Scotland into administrative counties, with each shire having its own structure.
entities.name: Shires of Scotland

desc: t

Sekban soldiers are recruited in large numbers from the Burghers, and financed by a special tax called the ''Sekban Aqçesi''. Typically fighting as infantry armed with muskets, they form the new core of the army, but are perpetually at odds with the Janissaries.
entities.name: Sekban System

desc: t
A form of rule inspired by the Venetian government, which combines aspects of a monarchy and a republic.
entities.name: Serene Republic of Naples

requires: event flag: Ned Seven Provinces Flag

desc: t
Instead of uniting all of our lands under our ruler, we have chosen to divide our nation into Seven Provinces, all with their own ambitions, but still serving us.
entities.name: Seven Provinces

desc: t
By placing market regulations on religious minorities, we can justify lower salaries for our armies, while also ensuring that any heretic or heathen remains in subjugation.
entities.name: Sahana-i-Mandi

desc: t

To manage the vast tide of merchants arriving at our ports, we appoint a Shāhbandar as the authority to oversee customs, resolve disputes, and organize the foreign quarters. This office brings order to our bustling entrepôt and will strengthen our role as the crossroads of the seas.
entities.name: Shāhbandariyya

desc: t

We are the defender of the righteous, and will protect our brethren in faith from any who dare lay their hands upon them. People of the one true faith will be able to seek shelter in our mighty bulwarks, where no heathen can harm them.
entities.name: Shield of the Faith

desc: t
As the military government of Japan, the authority of the Shōgun extends to every clan. At least, to those not bold enough to defy it...

mods.label: Cost of Appease the Elites Action

entities.name: Shogunate

gate: is leader of international organization: japanese shogunate
gate_labels: is leader of international organization: japanese shogunate
requires: the reform has been unlocked (Kanrei Council)
This Government Reform will be removed if the Japanese Shogunate no longer exists or if we are no longer the leader of the Japanese Shogunate.

desc: t

Seeking to form a more cohesive relationship between the Shōgun and Shugo Daimyō of Japan, a council of the many Kanrei allows Shugo Daimyō council members to advise the Shōgun while also engaging with other Shugo Daimyō council members. The senior members of the council are also tasked with handling the affairs of other, weaker clans in the council.
entities.name: Kanrei Council

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Signoria of Venice)

desc: t

The supreme governmental body of Venice, the Signoria puts great emphasis on collaboration between the Doge and other key positions of the state. The struggle for power between the council and the Doge therefore becomes a thing of the past.
entities.name: Signoria of Venice

desc: t

A specific Italian form of city republican government. Members are elected for a specific period of time, usually from among the most influential citizens of that city. However, in many cases they are also foreign rulers who are invited to rule the Signoria.
entities.name: Signoria

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Single Whip Law)

desc: t
In order to increase taxation efficiency, let us simplify all our different tax regimes into one: All payments to the government shall be made with Silver, and Silver only.
entities.name: Single Whip Law

desc: t
Newly conquered territories must be gradually assimilated to avoid resistance. Cultural and administrative policies will ensure a seamless absorption into the state.
entities.name: Recognition of Local Policies

desc: t

Our state is deeply connected with the dynastic affairs of the Mongol-ruled lands of China. The very core of our current government serves as the extension of the will of Yuán, our 'Father in Law', and our monarchs are obligated to marry Mongol princesses.
entities.name: 'Son in Law' Rule

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Trans-Saharan Trade)

desc: t

The trade routes of Trans-Saharan Africa have always brought wealth to West Africa and its empires. Instead of letting these routes decay, let us offer support to the caravans passing through our lands.
entities.name: Trans-Saharan Trade

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Songhai Militant Society)

desc: t

Rather than treating every eligible person in the country as a soldier, it is better to formally establish the distinction between a peasant and a full-time warrior. By dividing our realm into military regions, we will permit the governors to raise their own professional armies and serve the ruler.
entities.name: Songhai Militant Society

desc: t

Our realm is a proud product of its founder: Íñigo Iñiguez, nicknamed Arista, or ''The Oak''. Like the awe-inspiring tree that is his namesake, our nation is meant to endure and resist any forces that may threaten its existence.
entities.name: Sons of the Oak

desc: t

Unfortunately, votes can be bought, and old loyalties may cloud the judgment of some electors. Let us implement a semi-randomized system where names can be chosen from a pool of good candidates for important offices.
entities.name: Sortition

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Sovet Gospod)

desc: t

The Sovet Gospod — or the Council of Lords — is the decision-making institution of the Republic. Unlike the Veche system, the Sovet Gospod gives more power to Posadniks, Tysyatskys, and other members of the Nobility. Under this system, the influence of the Burghers and the Commoners is negligible.
entities.name: Sovet Gospod

desc: t

Governors of the Kingdom of Timurid who were appointed to the position because they either needed more experience before becoming the next ruler, because the area in question desperately needed a capable governor, or simply to exclude them from the active politics of the realm.
entities.name: Banished Soyurghal Governor

desc: t

Governors of the Kingdom of Timurid who were appointed to the position because they either needed more experience before becoming the next ruler, because the area in question desperately needed a capable governor, or simply to exclude them from the active politics of the realm.
entities.name: Soyurghal Governor

desc: t

Governors of the Kingdom of Timurid who were appointed to the position because they either needed more experience before becoming the next ruler, because the area in question desperately needed a capable governor, or simply to exclude them from the active politics of the realm.
entities.name: Tutorship Soyurghal Governor

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Iberian Tolerance)

desc: t

Iberia is inhabited by a multitude of people with different faiths and beliefs. To force them to follow one or to expel those with different beliefs than the ruling class would be a grave mistake, and hurt our country more than it would do good. For us to achieve greatness, we must embrace this diversity.
entities.name: Iberian Tolerance

desc: t
