The Speransky Liberalization Reform creates new legislative and executive bodies by introducing a series of regional Dumas. To mediate power between the autocrat and the Dumas, the State Council is made possible with the added purpose of examining any proposed laws.
entities.name: Speransky Liberalization Reform

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Standardized Relazioni)

desc: t
The 'Relazioni' are the reports our ambassadors send to the government, detailing the political, financial, and social state of the countries they serve in.
entities.name: Standardized Relazioni

desc: t
Naval trade operations must be supported by state funding. A well-maintained merchant fleet will boost commerce and provide auxiliary support for military endeavors.
entities.name: State-Backed Merchant Fleet

desc: t
The Church has been fully subjugated to the state.
entities.name: State-Controlled Church

desc: t
Trade hubs must be established with state backing to encourage commerce. Government support will ensure fair pricing and economic growth.
entities.name: State Sponsored Markets

desc: t
Selected Burghers must be granted exclusive trading privileges to regulate market competition. This will stimulate controlled economic growth and limit foreign interference.
entities.name: Statute Of Monopolies

desc: t

To ensure the continued prosperity of our government, we shall establish a new system of education for our elite. With a newly established separate institution, we can ensure access to the highest quality tutors while keeping their efforts centered on those who deserve it the most. With our government supported by these efforts, in time this will inspire our population to aspire to the same level of education.
entities.name: Study of the Classics

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Sūbah Organization)

desc: t

By strategically placing numerous governors within our realms, we can easily control every corner of our nation without having to worry about losing our grasp on them. It also allows us to urbanize areas more easily.
entities.name: Sūbah Organization

desc: t

The decision has been made to standardize our legal code, which originally developed as common law with significant regional variations. By streamlining this code and expanding the number of offenses subject to fines, we improve both administrative efficiency and state revenue.
entities.name: Sudebnik

desc: t

We have entered an Age of Liberty, in which the Crown shall no longer hold absolute sway! The government of Sweden is now in the hands of the estates, and the monarch may do nothing without first gaining our approval.
entities.name: Frihetstiden

desc: t

As our nation becomes more powerful, we need a way to unify the multiple councils that our rulers rely on. By creating a polysynodial system, we ensure that our realm is efficient by organizing all those councils to work together.
entities.name: System of Councils

desc: t

Taluqdars, or dynastic aristocrats, own extensive land, collect taxes, and play significant roles in our architecture and economy. As landowners with considerable power and influence in the court, the Taluqdars are our equivalent to the high nobility of other regions.
entities.name: Taluqdar Nobility

requires: religion group is Andean Folk Religions

desc: t

A government reform of the Incan Empire, adapted and evolved from its monarchic origins. Religious beliefs are inexorably intertwined with succession laws, which leads to new rulers starting their reigns owning nothing.
entities.name: Tawantinsuyu Monarchy

desc: t

Thalassocracy: rule by the sea. Ours is a people whose lives are lived out with, by, and for the ocean. Our empire stretches far beyond our homeland and into far-flung colonies in our extended Outremer, our Lands Beyond The Sea. From coast to coast beyond, our flags wave from ships upon the briny foam. The sea is cold, yet we have made it our home. Let no one challenge us in our proper element!
entities.name: Thalassocracy

desc: t
Every measure has been taken to prevent future strikes. All unlawful formations of trade or labor unions are henceforth prohibited!
entities.name: Restricted Worker Unions

desc: t

With a court of wards and liveries, the administration of tax collection and feudal dues is much more effective, due to increased expertise among collectors and a systemized revenue system. However, the nobility tend to consider such courts deeply exploitative of their own fortunes.
entities.name: The Court of Wards and Liveries

desc: t
Henceforth, education is compulsory for those who are to govern or otherwise work within our legal system.
entities.name: Mandatory Bureaucrat Education

desc: t
By using stealth and guile to intercept all kinds of written communications, we can stay ahead of our enemies and make our espionage more effective.
entities.name: Black Chambers

desc: t

We are the only surviving member of the formerly Muslim realms that populated Al-'Andalus in the past. Huge Muslim empires have risen and fallen throughout Iberia, fragmenting in the process. As one of those fragmented parts, it is our destiny to reunify the people of Iberia under our banner.

mods.label: War Score vs other Religion Efficiency

entities.name: The Jewel of Al-'Andalus

desc: t
Loyal citizens who report dangerous elements in our territory will be greatly rewarded by the state. We will establish numerous offices to more effectively report such activities to our government.
entities.name: Counter-Espionage Offices

desc: t

The Mestnichestvo is an ancient system that assigns positions of state to people based on the antiquity of their lineage and the seniority they hold within their families. The most tangible demonstration of this system involved the seating order of Boyars at the Tsar's table, which reflects their individual rank and precedence.
entities.name: Mestnichestvo

requires: has country modifier: Parliamentarists Victorious Modifier

desc: t

Emphasizing the values of military might and strong centralized power under the guidance of a Lord Protector, the Protectorate is a new style of government enforced after the victory of the Parliamentarians during the The English Civil War.
entities.name: Protectorate

desc: t
Forcibly requiring any able-bodied person without means of income to enlist for naval service will undoubtedly cause some controversy...
entities.name: Mandated Navy Service

desc: t
Establish a fixed system of transportation fees for goods to encourage the exportation of valuable items.
entities.name: Transportation Code

desc: t

A system of provincial headquarters and armies, spearheaded by a strategos with dual responsibilities to protect the locals and establish authority at the behest of the Byzantium. This system replaced the provincial administration of Diocletian and has served our people ever since. Yet time has worn it thin, it endures still, a relic of ages long past.
entities.name: Decayed Theme System

is leader of international organization: middle kingdom
gate_labels: court language.language family: chinese language family
is leader of international organization: middle kingdom
requires: has societal value: Sinicized vs Unsinicized
event flag: Unlocked Mandarin Language Reforms

desc: t

The Three Departments and Six Ministries System originate from ancient Chinese empires, and are the primary administrative structures of our state. Every department is responsible for several aspects of drafting, establishing, and revisiting state policies. The Six Boards are the six major executive bodies of the state, split in the respective affairs of state matters: employment, taxation, rites, military affairs, law enforcement, and public works.
entities.name: Three Departments

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Timurid Dīwān)

desc: t

We should abandon other forms of rule and legalize the Sharī'ah as the official law. This Timurid Dīwān will allow us to establish proper Islamic rule over any non-believers, as well as making it easier to grant governorship to our relatives.
entities.name: Timurid Dīwān

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Timurid Empire)

desc: t
The great ambitions of our founder have carved an empire of unimaginable expanse into the very face of Central Asia. Our bureaucracy therefore focuses heavily on expanding our borders.
entities.name: Timurid Empire

desc: t

Urban settlements are the muscles that power our country. Their sprawl attracts the majority of our population, and their bustling economies provide both opportunities and benefits for all. If we provide them with the appropriate laws, regulations, and privileges, we can ensure that they are most beneficial for us, each according to their situation and needs.
entities.name: Tailored Urban Rights

desc: t

In order to facilitate the flow of goods throughout our country and ensure the safety of every merchant setting foot on our territory, we should establish a permanent company of soldiers with the sole purpose of protecting our trade routes. Additionally, this organization shall also be tasked with the maintenance and construction of new roads.
entities.name: Professional Trade Guards

desc: t
A network of trade offices must be established to facilitate commerce and taxation. Centralized management will improve merchant interactions and state revenue.
entities.name: Trade Office Network

desc: t
Our state upholds the legacy of the Roman Empire, and is a stalwart of our state religion. As Tsar of the entire Russia, our ruler is the true overlord of the East Slavic peoples.
entities.name: Tsardom

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Tughlaq Slave Army)

desc: t
Due to a national surplus of slaves, we can use them to serve as an imperial guard. That way, we shall have a disciplined force on the battlefield while also ensuring the safety of the court.
entities.name: Tughlaq Slave Army

desc: t

In the Beylik of the Ottomans, the title of Pasha is bestowed by the Sultan upon high-ranking civil officials or military leaders. It is typically awarded to governors, and ranked above Beys and Aghas but below Khedives and Viziers.
entities.name: Pashas

desc: t

We shall support the efforts of our capital to centralize power in the hands of the government. A constant presence of our authority and might will ensure the cooperation of our estates and prevent any uprisings against our rule.
entities.name: Tyranny of the Capital

desc: t
A militaristic government responsible for maintaining an army with which to secure the domain and borders of its overlord.
entities.name: Uç Bey Government

requires: capital: has building with at least one level: Admiralty

desc: t
The admiralty should never be divided. It should serve the country alone. For that reason, we have united the numerous smaller admiralties within our nation.
entities.name: Unified Admiralty

desc: t
Commoners must be bound to the land to secure constant availability of agricultural labor. Nobility will be granted authority to oversee their estates with greater efficiency.
entities.name: Universal Serfdom

desc: t
Fix in law the precise military and economic obligations that our client states have towards us.
entities.name: Fixed Vassal Obligations

desc: t
This state is governed by a Veche, a council with the highest legislative and judicial authority consisting of Nobility, Burghers, and even Commoners.
entities.name: Veche Republic

desc: t

No city in Europe has confronted the threat of epidemic with more rigor than Venice, and the permanent ''Magistrato alla Sanità'' we have established is the most sophisticated public health institution in the world — staffed by physicians, notaries, and inspectors all bound to report the first signs of contagion to a central authority. When plague appears at our borders, the Magistracy holds the power to quarantine arriving ships in the lagoon for forty days, a measure we call ''quarantina'', and impose penalties on anyone who conceals sickness. This system has spared Venice from catastrophes that have emptied rival cities, and it keeps our workforce, our merchants, and our fleet healthy enough to sustain trade even as disease sweeps across the peninsula.
entities.name: Magistrato alla Sanità

desc: t

The original lending system in Italy was a joint stock fund called ''Monte Vecchio'', in which each citizen was required to lend a certain amount of money in exchange for interest. But with this updated iteration, our bankers have introduced a guaranteed minimum interest payment to lenders, which has increased the amount of money people are willing to invest. This 'Monte Nuovo' has been extremely successful, and should prove extremely lucrative over time.
entities.name: Monte Nuovo

desc: t

The mainland territories of the ''terraferma'' hold agricultural potential that poor drainage, neglect, and feudal indifference have left unrealized — marshes that could be grain fields, river banks that flood each spring and wash away the labor of the season before. We have established the ''Provveditori ai Beni Inculti'' with the authority to commission drainage canals, enforce irrigation schemes, and compensate landowners whose cooperation the works require. This systematic land improvement has extended the productive capacity of our wealthiest agricultural regions, giving Venice a food surplus that keeps the city fed even when sea trade is disrupted by war or blockade.
entities.name: Provveditori ai Beni Inculti

desc: t

Astadiggajas - ''Elephants in Eight Directions'' - is the collective title granted to the Telugu scholars and poets of our court. Their innovations influence our culture's artistic direction, and will lead us into a new golden era of creative and intellectual achievement.
entities.name: Astadiggajas

desc: t
Intellectuals and reformers must be supported to advance state policies. Innovative ideas will drive economic growth, military advancements, and governmental improvements.
entities.name: Visionary Thinkers

desc: t

The implementation of the Voivode makes it easier to govern large swaths of land by introducing a military governor who oversees the local administration and defense. An oath of allegiance is sworn directly to the ruler.
entities.name: Voivode

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Valakų Reform)

desc: t

With the Valakų Reform, our Nobility are more regulated in their behavior towards our subjects. This supports the Commoners within our realm, while also solidifying their status as an independent estate.
entities.name: Valakų Reform

gate: is situation active: red turban rebellions
is leader of international organization: middle kingdom
gate_labels: is situation active: red turban rebellions

desc: t
A state of the fractured Celestial Empire which rebels against the current Son of Heaven. Administrative issues are delayed in favor for a more aggressive focus on military expansion.

mods.label: Has Red Turban Rebellions Casus Belli

entities.name: Warring State

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Warsaw Confederation)

desc: t

Every noble, regardless of their religious affiliation, shall be permitted to vote and to live their lives as they wish. Moreover, they shall have the right to convert their subjects to their faith as they see fit. This resolution shall turn us into a safe haven and will promote religious tolerance.
entities.name: Warsaw Confederation

desc: t

Thousands of years of voyaging have taught our navigators how to traverse the seas. Bereft of advanced technology, the wayfinders memorize patterns in the stars and observe minute changes in the clouds and water to determine their position in the vast Pacific.
entities.name: Wayfinders

desc: t
Strict standards must be enforced for military armaments. Rigorous inspections and regulations will ensure superior weapon durability and effectiveness.
entities.name: Weapons Quality Standards

desc: t

Yeren Jurchen refers to Jurchen groups who occupy less-settled regions and maintain more traditional ways of life. They rely primarily on hunting and foraging, with less intensive agricultural practice.
entities.name: Yeren Jurchen

desc: t
The ownership of Livestock gives us much power, and controlling our country's cattle will help entrench our rule.
entities.name: Royal Ownership of Cattle

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Council of Senior Wives)

desc: t
This Council will offer us excellent advice, and involve the most skilled wives of our ruling class in the administration of our country.
entities.name: Council of Senior Wives

requires: the reform has been unlocked (Guild Constitution)

desc: t

Divided into a Major and Minor Council, twenty-six councilors shall rule over our domain. These will be recruited in equal numbers from the wealthy merchants, our guild craftsmen, and the nobility. This will ensure no faction will be able to achieve majority and rule without the consent of the others.
entities.name: Guild Constitution
